description: On the red bedspread there’s a green plate in the middle, with a yellow cheese-shaped piece to the left and several small toys and containers (a green block, a small figure, a blue cup, a strawberry, a blue case, and a white tray) around it. The right hand moves in from the right toward the small black-and-white figure, grips it as a right-hand object, lifts it up, then carries it down and places it onto the center of the green plate before releasing and pulling back.
